text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's government has unveiled a draft of the much-awaited indiginisation (black empowerment) policy, placing emphasis on strategies to increase black private sector investment, skills development, industrialisation of the economy and land redistribution.
- Zimbabwe's Export Processing Zone Authority (EPZA), which has been operational for the past 10 months, has so far approved 19 projects worth over Z$2 billion.
